title: Apply for a restricted driving instructor licence
summary: This page provides information and steps for applying for a restricted driving instructor licence to train licensed drivers.
intro:
A restricted driving instructor licence allows you to train drivers who are already licensed – such as defensive driver training for police and ambulance officers.

You are not licensed to teach learner drivers.

You can submit your initial application online or at a Service NSW Centre and have 6 months to meet all the requirements.

If you need more than 6 months you'll have to lodge another application. You will not require a new medical assessment, or to re-sit the theory and practical tests unless they were undertaken more than 18 months prior.

Note: There is a separate application procedure if you already hold an interstate licence.
who_can_apply: Hold a current full (unrestricted) Australian driver licence.
Have held an unrestricted licence in the class you wish to instruct for a minimum of 3 of the last 4 years.
Be a fit and proper person.
Have a safe driving record (parking offences are excluded).
Hold a TAE or Diploma in Education (or equivalent higher qualification).
what_you_need: A commercial medical assessment no more than 6 months prior.
Successfully complete the instructor knowledge test (90 questions) for the class of licence you wish to instruct, in English and without interpreter assistance.
Paid the 5-year non-refundable licence fee at a service centre.
A digital photo of yourself, or 2 passport size photos (if applying at a service centre).
If you haven't held a NSW driver licence for more than 5 years, provide a full driving record/history from the authority in the state or country where you previously held your driver licence.
A secondary proof of identity document (if you hold an interstate driver licence).
A copy of completion of the Certificate IV in Motor Vehicle Driver Training (TLI41222) module.
A copy of your TAE or Diploma in Education or equivalent higher qualification (as approved by TfNSW).
Proof of passing a TfNSW assessment on the Driving Instructor Act and Regulation, which requires signing a declaration.
The PDF form 'Application for Licence under Driving Instructors Act 1992' (if applying at a service centre).

how_to_steps.text: Select the 'Apply online' button.Note: You cannot save and resume your application once you've started.
Follow the prompts to submit your application.
Download and complete the Application for Licence under Driving Instructors Act 1992 – PDF.Note: Do not sign it – your signature must be witnessed at the service centre.
Visit a service centre and submit your application.

more_info.text: Restricted driving instructor licence applicants do not need:
Restricted licences are only available for car and motorcycle driving/riding instructors. They're not available for any heavy vehicle classes.

faqs.q: Can I teach learner drivers with this licence?
faqs.a: No, a restricted driving instructor licence only allows you to train drivers who are already licensed, such as for defensive driver training.

faqs.q: How long do I have to submit my initial application?
faqs.a: You have 6 months to meet all the requirements after submitting your initial application online or at a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: What if I need more than 6 months to meet the requirements?
faqs.a: If you need more than 6 months, you must lodge another application. You will not need a new medical assessment or to re-sit the theory and practical tests unless they were undertaken more than 18 months ago.
